name: aegis-beacon
description: Aegis-Beacon Node.js website: language-aware page rendering, i18n dictionaries (EN/IT/FR/ES) and Vercel serverless deployment.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check api/index.js && node --check translations.js && node --check views/layout.js && node --check views/landing.js && node --check views/wiki.js && node --check views/manual.js && node --check views/demo.js && node --check views/builder.js && node --check views/status.js && node --check views/wiki/layout.js && node --check views/wiki/overview.js && node --check views/wiki/hardware.js && node --check views/wiki/pinmap.js && node --check views/wiki/rf-design.js && node --check views/wiki/antenna.js && node --check views/wiki/firmware.js && node --check views/wiki/morse.js && node --check views/wiki/config.js && node --check views/wiki/display.js && node --check views/wiki/gps.js && node --check views/wiki/power.js && node --check views/wiki/assembly.js && node --check views/wiki/frequencies.js && node --check views/wiki/enclosure.js && node --check views/wiki/testing.js && node --check views/wiki/security.js && node --check views/wiki/faq.js && node --check views/wiki/glossary.js && node --check views/wiki/support.js && node -e "import('./translations.js').then(m => { const missing = m.validateDictionaries(); const bad = Object.entries(missing).filter(([, v]) => v.length); if (bad.length) { console.error('Missing translation keys:', JSON.stringify(bad)); process.exit(1); } console.log('i18n dictionaries OK: ' + m.SUPPORTED_LANGS.join(', ')); })"
